Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change, and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations: Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain, with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we are bolting on, it is central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we are heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations.

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused.

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes.

Who You Are

You are studying for a master's degree and want to see how a remote-first technology company really runs day to day. You like variety: one day might be a customer's supplier questionnaire, the next a recurring task you're automating with Claude. You enjoy working out how a process works and then making it better.

You work independently and in a structured way, and you're comfortable asking questions and working with Security, Legal and Finance to get something done. You care about the details, because supplier registrations and internal records need to be right. You're curious about AI and automation tools, and you want to use them on real work instead of just reading about them.

If you meet most of the qualifications below and the role interests you, apply. Curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more to us than a perfect match.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a working student to support our Operations and Financial Management department. The focus of this role is supporting the supplier registrations requested by our customers and helping us build and improve AI-supported workflows across the department. Your responsibilities include, among others:

  • Supporting the registration of Develocity as a supplier in our customers' procurement portals, including completing recurring questionnaires and gathering supporting evidence, in coordination with the Security, Legal, and Finance teams.
  • Learning our supplier registration process in depth, helping to implement improvements, and keeping the guides and training material up to date.
  • Building, testing, and improving AI-supported workflows with Claude, as well as with common automation tools, to reduce recurring manual work.
  • Helping to introduce new software tools, including writing short guides and answering questions from the teams.
  • Assisting our Business Administration team with recurring administrative tasks and keeping our internal records and systems up to date.
  • Supporting our Finance teams from time to time.
  • Taking on other tasks across the department as they come up, which lets you get to know several areas over time.

Minimum qualifications

  • Enrolment in a master's program, for example in business administration, business informatics, financial controlling, or a comparable field.
  • Basic understanding of business administration, attention to detail, and analytical thinking.
  • Flexibility and an open mind, as the role combines very different tasks from several teams.
  • An interest in improving current systems and processes, and you enjoy working with automation and AI tools such as Claude Code.
  • An independent, focused, and structured way of working, along with a collaborative mindset and good communication skills.
  • German at C2 or native level, English at B2 level or higher.

What We Offer

  • An immediate start, with weekly hours agreed individually around your studies.
  • A dynamic working environment in a Silicon Valley company with flat hierarchies and plenty of room for initiative and development.
  • Work at an international, fast-moving technology leader.
  • Onboarding and guidance from experienced colleagues.
  • In-person meetings, such as regular department and company meetings.
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment.
  • A diverse and inclusive environment in which we learn from one another. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences, skills and perspectives.

Location

  • Remote from anywhere in Germany.
  • Our headquarters is in San Francisco, and our teams work remotely across locations, which allows for a high degree of flexibility, collaboration and creativity. The Operations and Financial Management department is led from the Saarbrücken area in Germany and is responsible for the entire group.
  • While we work remotely, with everything in place for seamless collaboration by email, chat and video call, we deeply value in-person time and meet regularly as a department and as a company.

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der du Menschen überzeugst, Wissen vermittelst und nachhaltige Ergebnisse erzielst.
Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze die Haleon Markenwelt rund um Voltaren, Fenistil und Vitasprint.
In dieser abwechslungsreichen Rolle genießt du Benefits wie Firmenwagen, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Tagesschichten und keine Wochenendarbeit.

Account Executive

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC.

Wir suchen eine:n Account Executive, um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest an unseren Head of Sales und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Unser Sales Team ist ein zentraler Bestandteil für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Vom Erstkontakt mit einem Lead bis zum erfolgreichem Abschluss mit einem Kunden, berät das Team mittelständische Unternehmen zu unseren ganzheitlichen Energielösungen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Ermögliche signifikante Stromkosteneinsparungen bei unseren Kunden durch gezielte Positionierung unserer Lösungen zur intelligenten Stromversorgung und Steuerung von Batteriespeichern

  • Arbeite eng mit unserem Vertriebsinnendienst zusammen, um effiziente und reibungslose Vertriebsprozesse zu gewährleisten

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Sales Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut

  • Du hast dich als fester Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden rund um unsere Lösungen etabliert - und berätst sie ganzheitlich und kompetent

  • Du hast mehrere Kundenprojekte bereits umfangreich entwickelt, sodass erste vertriebliche Erfolge zeitnah absehbar sind

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrungen in der B2B-Kundenkommunikation, z. B. als Account Executive, Account Manager oder im Business Development Bereich

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft bzw. Erneuerbare Energien ist ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (mindestens Bachelor)

  • Ausgeprägte Überzeugungskraft und ein sicheres Gespür für Gesprächssituationen

  • Interesse an energiewirtschaftlichen Lösungen und intrinsische Motivation, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Starkes Organisationstalent und Fähigkeit, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld zu setzen

  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum trawa?

Our hypothesis is that our platform, our purchasing power, our credit facilities and our automation take them past that limit. Your job is to find out on the ground whether that hypothesis holds, in which order, and at what pace - and then to make it happen with the management team, not to them.

    About The Role

    The Senior IT Analyst is the principal in-house resource responsible for day-to-day IT support, providing first and second-line user support and day-to-day IT operations for approximately 80 users. As the principal person responsible for day-to-day IT operations, they will take ownership of incidents and service requests across the support lifecycle rather than operating solely as an escalation resource.
     
    This is a broad, senior analyst role for someone who is technically capable, comfortable working independently and able to manage competing priorities. The postholder will respond directly to users, resolve routine enquiries and requests, investigate more complex issues through to resolution and coordinate external technology suppliers where specialist expertise is needed. Alongside business-as-usual responsibilities, the role will support and deliver smaller technology projects and service improvements.
     
    By keeping FAIRR’s technology secure, reliable and easy to use, the role enables colleagues to focus on delivering FAIRR’s mission with investors and partners worldwide.


    Key Outcomes & Accountabilities

    OUTCOME 1: Users receive dependable, responsive IT support, with issues owned and resolved end to end

    • Act as the principal in-house point of contact for day-to-day IT support, providing both first and second-line assistance according to operational needs.
    • Resolve straightforward incidents and requests promptly, while taking the lead on more complex technical issues requiring deeper investigation and second-line expertise.
    • Own and manage incidents and service requests from initial contact through to resolution, including access, software, equipment, permissions and non-standard user requirements, coordinating third-party suppliers or specialist support when required.
    • Monitor recurring issues, identify root causes and implement practical improvements to reduce repeat incidents.
    • Maintain accurate support records and produce clear information on service volumes, performance, trends and user experience.
     
    OUTCOME 2: Joiners, movers and leavers have the right access and equipment at the right time, and no more
    • Coordinate all IT activities for joiners, movers and leavers in collaboration with HR and relevant managers.
    • Create, amend and remove user accounts, licences, group memberships, permissions and application access accurately and on time, including removal of leaver access no later than the end of their last working day (or earlier where instructed by P&C).
    • Prepare, issue, recover and securely manage laptops, mobile devices, peripherals and other IT equipment.
    • Perform periodic access reviews and maintain appropriate evidence of approvals and completed actions.
    • Manage shared, service and other non-person accounts, ensuring ownership, purpose and access are recorded.
    • Where instructed by P&C or the Senior IT Manager, securely preserve or retrieve account and device data to support subject access requests, investigations or legal matters, maintaining confidentiality throughout.
     
    OUTCOME 3: IT changes are implemented in a controlled way with minimal disruption
    • Plan, assess, document, communicate and implement routine IT changes in a controlled manner.
    • Ensure changes have appropriate approvals, testing, implementation steps, back-out arrangements and post-change review where proportionate.
    • Maintain the IT change schedule and coordinate activities to minimise disruption to users and business operations.
    • Communicate planned changes clearly to affected users and stakeholders.
    • Where changes need to take place outside normal working hours, schedule these in advance with the Senior IT Manager’s agreement (see Section 8).
     
    OUTCOME 4: IT services and workplace technology operate reliably and are used effectively and securely
    • Administer Microsoft 365 and other cloud applications used by the organisation, including routine configuration, licence and user administration.
    • Support laptops, mobile devices, meeting-room technology, printers, connectivity and standard workplace applications.
    • Coordinate hardware repairs, replacements, warranty cases, software renewals and operational supplier activities.
    • Maintain user guides, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures and support documentation.
    • Provide practical guidance and training that helps users make effective and secure use of technology.
     
    OUTCOME 5: IT records, controls and evidence are complete, current and audit-ready
    • Maintain complete and accurate asset, software, licence, supplier and other operational IT registers.
    • Record equipment allocation, ownership, status, location, lifecycle and disposal information, and perform periodic reconciliations.
    • Follow and help maintain IT policies, standards, procedures and control evidence.
    • Complete routine operational checks and scheduled control activities, escalating risks, exceptions or control failures promptly.
    • Support audits, reviews and compliance activities by providing accurate records and evidence.
    • Handle devices, accounts and information in line with security, privacy and records-management requirements.
    • Support compliance with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 (as amended by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025), including immediately escalating any suspected personal data breach to the Data Protection Lead so that the organisation can meet the 72-hour ICO reporting deadline where applicable.
     
    OUTCOME 6: Small projects and improvements are delivered and technology keeps getting better
    • Deliver or support small IT projects, upgrades, application roll-outs and service improvements.
    • Gather requirements, coordinate suppliers, plan user communications, support testing and manage implementation activities.
    • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency and the user experience.
    • Keep project actions, risks, decisions, documentation and handover materials up to date.


    Success Measures

    Success in the role will be assessed through:
     
    Service delivery

    • Users receive dependable and responsive first and second-line technical support, with routine and complex issues resolved effectively.
    • Incidents and requests are responded to and resolved within agreed service levels.
    • User satisfaction with IT support is consistently positive.
    Accuracy, security and control
    • Incidents, requests, access changes and joiner, mover and leaver activities are completed accurately and on time.
    • 100% of leaver accounts disabled by the end of the last working day; new joiners fully equipped and set up on day one.
    • Operational records, registers and control evidence are complete, current and reliable.
    • Periodic access reviews and asset reconciliations completed on schedule with no significant audit findings.
    Change and improvement
    • Changes and small projects are delivered in a controlled way with minimal disruption.
    • Recurring problems are reduced and practical improvements are implemented continuously.
    • Feedback from the Senior IT Manager, colleagues and suppliers on collaboration, communication and ownership.


    Technical Expertise & Role-Specific Capability

    Essential

    • Strong hands-on experience providing both first and second-line IT support within a modern workplace environment, with particular strength in diagnosing and resolving more complex technical issues.
    • Demonstrable experience managing a broad range of incidents and service requests through their full lifecycle, from initial user contact to resolution.
    • Practical experience of joiner, mover and leaver processes, identity administration, permissions and access control.
    • Experience administering Microsoft 365 and supporting Windows devices, laptops, mobile devices and common business applications.
    • Experience maintaining IT asset records, operational registers, procedures and control evidence.
    • Understanding of proportionate change management, information security and data protection practices.
    • Ability to troubleshoot methodically, make sound decisions and know when to engage specialist support.
    • Experience coordinating external IT suppliers and seeing actions through to completion.
    • Ability to organise a varied workload independently and balance urgent support needs with planned operational work.
    • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical matters to non-technical users.
    • Experience contributing to or delivering small IT projects and technology changes.
     
    Desirable
    • Experience in a small organisation where the role covers a broad range of operational IT responsibilities.
    • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Autopilot, SharePoint and Teams administration.
    • Experience with IT service management tools and ITIL-aligned working practices.
    • Experience supporting SaaS applications and coordinating managed service, cyber security or other specialist partners.
    • Relevant technical or service management certification (e.g. Microsoft 365 / Azure certifications, ITIL Foundation), or equivalent practical experience.


    Career Framework Expectations

    Our Career Framework provides a shared approach to development and performance across the organisation. It is built around four core pillars: Connect, Deliver, Focus and Lead, which outline the key behaviours and expectations expected at all levels.
    In this role, the pillars look like this:

    CONNECT — Building trust, relationships and collaboration

    • Collaborative and able to build effective relationships with users, colleagues and suppliers.
    • Technically credible, user-focused and committed to providing a high-quality service.
    DELIVER — Driving outcomes and execution
    • Proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
    • Calm and organised when handling competing priorities or service disruption.
    FOCUS — Applying expertise and driving improvement
    • Detail-oriented and disciplined about keeping records, documentation and actions up to date.
    • Curious and improvement-minded, with a willingness to learn and adapt.
    LEAD — Leading self, others and organisational success
    • Practical and proportionate, applying appropriate control without unnecessary bureaucracy.
    • Role-models secure and responsible use of technology and shares knowledge so colleagues become more self-sufficient.


    Organisational Values

    1. We are change makers: keeps the technology behind FAIRR’s work dependable, so colleagues can spend their time on the mission rather than on IT problems.
    2. We collaborate: works closely with HR, managers, colleagues and suppliers to deliver a joined-up service.
    3. We innovate: looks for better, simpler and more secure ways of working, and delivers improvements that last.
    4. We act with integrity: handles privileged access, devices and personal data responsibly, confidentially and transparently.


    Additional Information

    Working Arrangements
    Hybrid working from near Marble Arch (Oxford Street), London, UK, in line with FAIRR’s organisational working arrangements.
     
    Normal working hours are 9.00am–5.30pm, Monday to Friday. Because much of the role is hands-on (devices, meeting-room technology, joiner set-up), the postholder will be expected to work on site at least 3 days per week and on key operational days such as new starter inductions.
     
    Occasional work outside normal hours may be required for planned changes or urgent incidents. This will be agreed in advance wherever possible and recognised through time off in lieu in line with FAIRR policy.

    Travel Requirements
    Occasional travel within London and the UK may be required (e.g. supplier visits, training or events). International travel is not an expected part of the role.

    Salary Range
    To be confirmed during recruitment stage.

    Benefits
    Benefits will be provided in line with FAIRR’s standard employee benefits package.

    Pre-Employment Checks
    Appointment is subject to proof of the right to work in the UK, satisfactory references and, because the role holds privileged system access, a Basic DBS criminal record check. Information will be handled in line with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and data protection law.
     
    Equal Opportunities & Reasonable Adjustments
    FAIRR welcomes applications from all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process or in the role, please let us know.

    Performance & Flexibility

    • This JD forms the basis for performance reviews.
    • Performance against this JD will be reviewed during the 5-month probationary period and in regular one-to-ones thereafter.

    About Pleo

    Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

    The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

    Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

    About the role

    We’re looking for a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager to lead our KYC Framework & Controls team in Pleo’s first line of defence. The team owns our financial crime framework across the UK and EU/EEA, covering KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening. You’ll lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on, owning change end to end across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Compliance is a given; the bigger opportunity is using AI and technology to cut manual effort and sharpen our controls. We welcome all backgrounds, so apply even if you don’t tick every box.

    Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

    You’ll report to our DK/EEA MLRO and lead a remote team of five financial crime specialists. You’ll partner with Operations, who run our KYC processes, plus Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance and our separate transaction monitoring team.

    What you’ll be doing

    As a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager, you will:

    • Own and evolve Pleo’s financial crime framework for KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening across the UK and EU/EEA

    • Lead and support a remote team of specialists, building trust and a real sense of team

    • Drive change end to end, from spotting the gap to embedding the fix with Operations

    • Use automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve decision quality

    • Lead our move to a new screening vendor through to go-live

    • Shape our readiness for the EU AML Regulation

    • Manage regulatory audits and inspections, and help set the team’s annual strategy

    On the roadmap: the screening vendor migration (go-live planned for Q1) and the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. We’re also finalising a new financial crime operating model, so some responsibilities may shift.

    What you bring


    You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

    • Significant experience designing and improving financial crime frameworks, controls and operating models in the UK or EU

    • Experience across multiple entities and jurisdictions, covering UK and EU/EEA requirements

    • Experience managing specialists while staying hands-on

    • A track record of leading change end to end, from stakeholders to delivery

    • Demonstrable experience driving innovation, for example AI-enabled workflows or automated controls

    • The ability to turn complex financial crime concepts into clear, practical guidance

    It’s a bonus if you have:

    • Led a screening vendor migration or a similar system implementation

    • Hands-on experience preparing for the EU AML Regulation

    You might come from a fintech or a bank. If you’re from a larger bank, show us where you’ve owned broad scope.

    Why is this role a good fit for you

    This role is a good fit for you if:

    • You want broad ownership across KYC, AML and sanctions

    • You get energy from finding efficiencies and putting AI to work on real problems

    • You lead specialists by building trust and giving them room

    This role is not a good fit for you if:

    • You want a pure people-management role. You’ll be in the detail as well as leading

    • You need fully settled scope. Our operating model is being finalised, and some responsibilities may move

    • You’d rather lead an office-based team. Yours is fully remote, and connection takes deliberate effort

    How you’ll develop in this role

    In your first six months at Pleo, you’ll:

    • Take ownership of the screening vendor migration and lead it through go-live

    • Take day-to-day ownership of the EU AML Regulation programme

    • Bring your remote team closer together

    Beyond that, you’ll lead the AI and efficiency agenda across financial crime, with room to grow your scope as the operating model matures.

    Show me the benefits!

    • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

    • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

    • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

    • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

    • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

    • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

    • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we’re supportive of families and help you feel that you don’t have to compromise your family due to work


    The interview process

    We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

    • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

    • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the DK/EEA MLRO about your experience and leadership. 45mins.

    • Pleo Challenge: Walk us through the efficiency opportunities you see in one of our processes. 1 hour.

    • Peer interview: 1 hour

    Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

    We are receiving a really high volume of applicants but can only select so many for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

    • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

    • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

    • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

    About your application

    • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

    Role purpose

    Plentific is standing up a Controlling PMO: a function with the mandate to set and enforce common delivery standards, hold a single, current view of the whole portfolio, and work directly with senior management to unblock the issues that put individual projects’ targets at risk. The PMO Lead owns this function day to day — coaching Programme and Project Managers (PMs) to a consistently high standard, building the portfolio-level reporting that gives leadership real visibility, and acting as the bridge between delivery teams and senior management when a decision or an unblock is needed.

    This is a hands-on, first-of-its-kind role at Plentific: the PMO Lead will stand up the standards, cadence, and reporting described below largely from scratch, and will be judged on how quickly the portfolio becomes visible, consistent, and genuinely governed as a result.


    Key responsibilities

    1. Coach Programme & Project Managers, and hold the standard

    • Own and continuously improve the standard toolkit every programme uses — charter, RAID log, status report, change log.

    • Coach PMs on using the standards well — raising the general standard of programme management practice, not just chasing form-filling.

    • Own the stage-gate review process: assess whether a programme is genuinely ready to pass each gate, and issue go/no-go sign-off.

    • Set and enforce mandatory reporting — PMs submit standard, current status on a fixed cadence; the PMO follows up where reporting lapses.

    2. Build and run portfolio-level reporting and governance

    • Consolidate individual programme status into one current, accurate portfolio view of schedule, spend, risk, and resourcing.

    • Own the portfolio tracker and the cadence of updates that feed it.

    • Track cross-programme risks and dependencies; make sure each has a named owner and a clear escalation threshold.

    • Prepare and present the portfolio report at each Steering Committee review.

    • Track benefits realisation — confirm delivered programmes actually produced the outcome they were funded for.

    3. Work with senior management to report and unblock

    • Act as the primary escalation point when a programme risk or dependency needs a decision above the PM’s authority.

    • Bring blockers to the right senior stakeholder quickly, with a clear ask and options — not just a status update.

    • Authority, via the PMO charter, to require compliance with standards and mandatory reporting across all active programmes.

    • Owns sign-off at stage gates — a programme cannot proceed to the next phase without PMO gate approval.

    • Is the named escalation path for cross-programme risk and resourcing conflicts.

    • Does not directly manage PMs day to day: PMs remain people-managed within their business unit, with a functional (“dotted-line”) reporting relationship into the PMO for delivery standards, gate compliance, and escalation.

    • Executive Sponsor / Steering Committee — monthly portfolio reporting, escalation, gate decisions.

    • PMO Analyst (future hire) — as the portfolio grows, this role would oversee a second PMO hire supporting reporting and gate reviews.

    • Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

    • Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.

    The Role

    Lexroom is building its partnership channel and wants it to become a material driver of revenue growth.     You will turn the partnership strategy into signed agreements and partner-sourced pipeline. This is a hands-on role with high ownership and a direct line to commercial leadership.

    🌀 The Company

    Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

    Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

    At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

    As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

     

    🎯 The Role

    We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran.

    We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey.

    You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead.

    💼 Your Responsibilities

    • Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast.

    • Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

    • Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce.

    • Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond.

    • Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures.

    • Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours.

    • Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone.

    • Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises.

    🤝 Who You'll Work With

    • Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team.

    • Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO.

    • Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows.

    🧬 Profile We're Looking For

Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations, supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing.

    Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers:

    • Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback

    • Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans

    • Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing

    • Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring

    Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases:

    • Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through

    • Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk

    • Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success)

    • Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support

    Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo:

    Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business.

    • Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle

    • Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions

Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

Cribl sells to organizations large and small, but we are looking for a Regional Sales Manager with experience selling large and complex deals into SLED for the Ohio Valley Region.

A successful Regional Sales Manager at Cribl can clearly articulate our value proposition and execute on proven sales processes. As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Track record of landing and expanding 7-figure deals within the SLED community
  • Experience navigating long sales cycles with multiple buying centers and executive stakeholders
  • Comfortable selling multi-product, complex tech to various personas—technical and non-technical

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager partners with our larger midsize and regional customers to secure their entire digital experience.

You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment and navigate complex, matrixed organisations to connect customers with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.


Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • You will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and sell Palo Alto Networks Products and Solutions through Channel Partners and by interacting directly with customers in your region to consistently achieve and exceed regional revenue targets
  • You will own and develop a diverse set of customers in a selected set of complex accounts, focusing on long-term value creation.
  • Leverage consultative selling experience will help you identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and existing customers, architecting comprehensive cybersecurity transformation across network, cloud and SOC environments
  • Lead multi-threaded sales engagements involving senior executive stakeholders, technical buyers, and procurement teams, to navigate enterprise purchasing complexities and secure large-scale, multi year deployments.
  • Master the competitive landscape, trends, and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions.
  • Create clear goals and accurate forecasting, developing detailed, data driven territory and deep account plans aligned with the customer business priorities.
  • You will identify, prioritize, and focus on the largest opportunities within the territory, maximizing total contract value while balancing breadth of coverage with depth on higher-value deals.
  • Build and leverage C-level relationships (CIO, CISO, CSO, and equivalent) to establish Palo Alto Networks as a trusted strategic partner.
  • You will leverage channel and marketing programs as well as sales plays to drive pipeline generation and expand coverage across the region both with existing and new customers.
  • You will collaborate with the specialist sales teams driving cross-platform adoption and ensure the best solution for our customers and prospects.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry.
  • Experience selling into mid-size and large enterprises, typically with multi-billion-dollar revenue and global or multi-regional operations.
  • Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage high-value accounts with extended sales cycles while operating in a high-variance environment.
  • Comfort managing accounts of different sizes, deal complexity, and sales readiness; deals may range from mid-market cycles to six & seven-figure, enterprise-scale opportunities.
  • Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems.
  • Cultivated relationships with our channel partners to bring a channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers.
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes, including legal, security, and commercial negotiations.
  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process.
  • Experience collaborating closely with a specialist sales organization to position the complete portfolio with prospects and customers.
  • Excellent time management skills and a history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets in a regional sales environment.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are seeking Remote Inbound Customer Service Representatives to provide exceptional support to customers calling in with questions or concerns. This role is ideal for individuals who are empathetic, patient, and committed to delivering high-quality service from a home-based environment.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer inbound customer calls in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Assist with inquiries, complaints, and service-related issues.
  • Provide accurate information about products, services, and policies.
  • Document customer interactions and feedback in the system.
  • Follow company procedures and escalate complex issues when necessary.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous customer service or call center experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
  • Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
  • Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. ABOUT US

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

A Snapshot of Curvion Blue:

Curvion Blue is a high performance RevOps agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales 🤪Put simply, our clients outsource their sales department to us and we sell their services to help them scale faster than ever before while changing as many people’s lives as possible. We architect entire end-to-end sales solutions by designing custom sales motions, integrating battle-tested systems, developing go to market strategies powered by our proprietary playbooks, and then hiring, training, and managing a highly trained on demand sales force to deploy faster and more predictable revenue engines. The current verticals we serve are the alternative education space that sell transformative programs including everything from business consulting programs, to programs that teach people how to invest in real estate, learn mergers and acquisitions and many many more, along with the software as a service (SaaS) vertical, bringing cutting edge technology products to market. In short, we’re a full-stack RevOps implementation partner that installs full cycle turnkey selling systems for our clients.

Position Overview:

At Curvion Blue, we don’t just onboard team members. We deploy high-performance revenue operators into live fire environments with precision and velocity.

The Director of Sales Training sits at the core of our talent activation engine. This role owns the entire learning lifecycle for all new sales hires and ongoing performance development across the organization. From day one ramp to long-term skill stacking, this person ensures every rep is not just “trained,” but fully operational, battle-tested, and continuously evolving.

This is not a passive facilitation role. This is a high-impact, high-ownership leadership function responsible for building, refining, and executing the systems that turn raw talent into revenue producers. You will design onboarding frameworks, lead recurring training cadences, dissect call performance at scale, and continuously optimize the training ecosystem based on real-world performance data.

You are the bridge between strategy and execution, turning sales theory into daily behavioral output that drives measurable revenue outcomes across every brand and account we operate.

You SHOULD apply to this role if:

  • You have built or led high-performance sales training or enablement programs

  • You understand how to take inexperienced reps and ramp them into consistent closers

  • You have deep experience in high-ticket sales environments

  • You are equally fluent in coaching soft skills and dissecting hard performance data

  • You know how to build training systems that actually stick, not just sound good

  • You thrive in fast-moving, high-accountability, no-fluff environments

  • You are obsessed with call reviews, performance patterns, and behavioral optimization

  • You can design onboarding journeys that shorten ramp time without sacrificing quality

  • You understand CRMs, pipelines, and sales metrics at a tactical level

  • You are comfortable running live training sessions, workshops, and recurring enablement meetings

  • You naturally turn underperformance into structured improvement plans

  • You enjoy building order out of chaos and scaling what works

  • You are energized by developing talent at scale and watching reps level up quickly

You SHOULD NOT apply if:

  • You have never owned or led a sales training or enablement function

  • You avoid data and prefer “gut feel” over performance analytics

  • You struggle to coach underperforming reps with direct, actionable feedback

  • You cannot translate sales performance into structured training content

  • You are uncomfortable reviewing calls, pipelines, and rep behavior in detail

  • You prefer static environments with minimal change or iteration

  • You are not confident running group training sessions or leading rooms

  • You get overwhelmed by fast-paced, high-volume sales environments

  • You think training is a one-time onboarding event instead of a continuous system

  • You are not excited by accountability, metrics, and measurable outcomes

  • You lack experience in high-performance sales organizations

  • You eat your pizza with ranch (may be flexible on this one)

Major Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Own and execute the full onboarding and ramp process for all new sales hires

  • Design, build, and continuously improve Curvion Blue's Sales Training Center (STC) curriculum

  • Lead all new hire training cohorts from kickoff through full ramp completion

  • Run recurring weekly and daily enablement sessions for active sales teams

  • Develop role-specific training modules for setters, closers, and hybrid roles

  • Review sales calls at scale and translate insights into structured coaching frameworks

  • Build performance-based feedback loops tied directly to revenue outcomes

  • Partner with Sales Directors to identify skill gaps and create targeted interventions

  • Continuously refine objection handling, closing frameworks, and discovery processes

  • Monitor rep ramp time, conversion rates, and productivity benchmarks

  • Standardize best practices across all accounts and ensure adoption across teams

  • Collaborate with recruiting and leadership to improve hiring-to-ramp alignment

  • Support live deal strategy coaching and real-time performance support

  • Maintain and evolve internal training documentation, playbooks, and SOPs

  • Identify top performer behaviors and systemize them into repeatable training assets

  • Ensure training alignment with CRM data, pipeline structure, and reporting accuracy

  • Work cross-functionally with leadership to support scaling initiatives and new account launches

  • Drive continuous improvement in sales effectiveness across all Curvion Blue's brands and teams

  • Monday to Friday

About impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight.

As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on.

About Offshore Launch

Offshore Launch is a staffing agency that specializes in helping small business owners scale their operations with the top 1% of global remote talent. We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every person and business in a better position than we found them.

Why Join Offshore Launch?

  • Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses.
  • Work in a people-first, remote environment that values growth and ongoing development.
  • Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, professional development, and an overall emphasis on teamwork and collaboration.
  • Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence.

Your Role

As an employee of Offshore Launch, you are being hired for a unique role within a target Client’s company. We value long-term partnerships, and seek to recruit talent that will serve an individual Client’s business for multiple years.

You will work full-time with the Client company. However, the Agency provides ongoing support to ensure your continued success. As such, we create space for ongoing check-ins, feedback and development through:

  • Membership in the Offshore Launch Slack workspace
  • Bi-weekly All Team meetings
  • Monthly reviews

Your job is to help the Client succeed.

Our job is to help you succeed.

About the Client

The Roofing Operations Coordinator is the quality gate between the Sales and Operations teams. Every job the sales team signs passes through this role before it enters the production queue. You will confirm that each job is complete and accurate (scope, pricing, documentation, checklists and photos) and send anything that isn't back for correction.

You will also own the administrative work that moves a job from signed contract to completed roof. This includes supporting customer financing document upload, reconciling change orders, preparing permit applications and submitting manufacturer warranties. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, process-driven person who takes pride in getting things right and is comfortable holding others to a standard.

Responsibilities

Job Review and Approval (Gatekeeper to Operations)

  • Review every job signed by the residential sales team before it is released to the production queue.
  • Verify that scope of work and pricing are accurate and consistent with the contract and internal requirements.
  • Confirm that all required job information is captured and that every sales checklist is fully completed.
  • Confirm that all required photos are present and usable.
  • Approve jobs that meet the standard and release them to production.
  • When a job is incomplete or incorrect, flag the specific issues and send it back to the responsible salesperson for correction. Jobs do not move to production until corrections are made.
  • Track returned jobs through to resolution so nothing stalls.

Financing Support

  • Help facilitate customer financing on signed jobs.
  • Collect required documentation from customers and the sales team.
  • Upload documentation to lender portals and the job management system.
  • Monitor application status and follow up on missing or outstanding items until funding is complete.

Change Order Reconciliation

  • Reconcile change orders in ServiceTitan so that scope, pricing and invoicing reflect the work actually performed.
  • Identify discrepancies between the original contract, change orders and completed work, and escalate them to Sales or Production for resolution.

Permit Support

  • Prepare and enter permit applications in iPermit using information from the sales checklist.
  • Verify that permit data is accurate and complete before submission.
  • Track permit status and flag delays or requests for additional information.

Roof Warranty Registration

  • Submit manufacturer roof warranty applications for completed jobs.
  • Confirm that all warranty requirements and documentation are met.
  • Track applications through issuance and file warranty documentation to the job record.

Requirements

Required

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined, checklist-driven approach to work.
  • Confidence to hold colleagues to a standard and send incomplete work back for correction.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of jobs at different stages without letting items fall through the cracks.
  • Ability to work full time during U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred

  • Experience in roofing, solar, construction or home services.
  • Experience working in a CRM or field service management platform.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceTitan.
  • Familiarity with U.S. building permit processes, consumer financing or manufacturer warranty programs.

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch)

  • Up to $1450, depending on experience
  • 13th month pay
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive HMO policy, including dependents.
  • Annual continuing education budget to support professional development

Note

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.
