The Security Operations Engineer builds and operates security controls, tooling, and automation across DeepHealth's cloud and corporate environments. This role is responsible for configuring, integrating, and maintaining the enterprise security tooling stack, developing detection content, and automating security operations tasks so that controls are repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable.

Working within DeepHealth's established security frameworks and under the direction of the Director, Security Operations, this position operates and tunes security controls, detection content, and guardrails. Independent validation of those controls sits with the security operations watch function — a deliberate separation that keeps the control environment defensible under audit. Remediation follows system ownership across Cloud Operations, Platform, and Application Development; this role supplies technical guidance and implements fixes directly where the control is security-owned.

This position operates within a regulated healthcare environment across a global operating footprint, with obligations under HIPAA, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2. The role reports to the Director, Security Operations, with future reporting to the Manager, Security Operations as that position is established.

Requirements

  • Build, configure, integrate, and tune the enterprise security tooling stack across cloud and corporate environments.
  • Develop and maintain detection content, correlation rules, and response automation within the SIEM and SOAR platform.
  • Onboard new log sources and telemetry feeds, validating ingestion completeness, parsing accuracy, and field normalization.
  • Administer and tune endpoint detection and response tooling, including policy configuration, exclusion governance, and coverage validation.
  • Integrate security tooling with adjacent platforms through APIs to reduce manual handling and improve data quality.
  • Implement and maintain security configurations, guardrails, and baselines across Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, and Microsoft Azure.
  • Build and maintain security automation and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or an equivalent framework, so that controls are version-controlled, repeatable, and auditable.
  • Implement policy-as-code and preventive guardrails using native cloud policy engines or an equivalent open policy framework.
  • Support cloud security posture management across all cloud environments, including finding deduplication, theme mapping, and routing to owning teams.
  • Harden cloud resources including compute, storage, database, container, and serverless services against established benchmarks.
  • Configure and maintain Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls, including conditional access, identity protection, and Defender workloads in a hybrid directory environment.
  • Implement and maintain least-privilege access models, roles, and policies across multiple cloud identity systems.
  • Implement container and Kubernetes security controls, including role-based access control, workload security standards, image scanning, and runtime protection.
  • Implement and maintain secrets management practices and tooling, and support the elimination of hard-coded credentials across environments.
  • Operate vulnerability management tooling, validate scan coverage, and translate raw scanner output into prioritized, owner-routed findings.
  • Provide technical remediation guidance to cloud, platform, identity, application, and endpoint owners, who retain accountability for closure of findings in their systems.
  • Implement engineering fixes for findings that fall to security-owned tooling and configuration.
  • Support remediation tracking for penetration test and vulnerability assessment findings by supplying technical detail and validating that fixes are technically sound.
  • Support incident detection and response through hands-on technical investigation, including log analysis, endpoint examination, identity and authentication tracing, and cloud audit log review.
  • Support escalations raised by the external managed security partner by supplying technical analysis and environment context.
  • Provide feedback into detection quality and alert tuning to reduce noise and improve signal for the monitoring function.
  • Contribute technical findings to post-incident review, and implement the resulting control and detection improvements.
  • Participate in tabletop exercises and resilience testing, and act on the technical gaps those exercises surface.
  • Document all engineering changes to security controls through the change management process, including validation criteria and rollback plans.
  • Produce and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and technical operating procedures for repeatable security operations tasks.
  • Write clear, documented, and reviewable code and configuration so that work can be inspected, maintained, and handed over without dependence on any one individual.
  • Support audit, certification, and customer assurance activities by producing technical evidence on request.
  • Maintain accurate inventory of security tooling, control coverage, licensing position, and control operating status.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of security testing results, control configuration detail, and investigative material, and follow established standards for external disclosure.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, security engineering, or a comparable technical security role. (Required)
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. (Required)
  • 2+ years of hands-on cloud security experience across at least one major cloud provider; Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services preferred. (Required)
  • 2+ years operating and tuning a SIEM platform, including working with detection content and log sources. (Required)
  • 1+ year administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls in a hybrid directory environment. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of security automation; experience with scripting and infrastructure-as-code is required, with Terraform experience preferred. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of cloud security posture management and preventive controls. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of container and Kubernetes security, including role-based access control and image scanning. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of secrets management tooling and practices. (Required)
  • Practical experience with endpoint detection and response tooling. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of vulnerability management and the finding remediation lifecycle, including risk-based prioritization. (Required)
  • Scripting capability in at least one of: Python, PowerShell, or Bash. (Required)
  • Familiarity with recognized security frameworks including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2. (Required)
  • Able to communicate technical findings clearly in writing and verbally to both technical and non-technical audiences. (Required)
  • Able to manage assigned work independently and escalate appropriately. (Required)
  • Available to support incident response activity outside standard business hours as required. (Required)
  • Microsoft Office experience. (Required)
  • Industry certification such as Security+, CompTIA CySA+, or a cloud provider security certification. (Preferred)
  • Experience in healthcare, medical device, or another regulated industry, and working familiarity with HIPAA obligations. (Preferred)
  • Experience working alongside or integrating with a managed security service provider. (Preferred)

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

Position Title: Cardiac Device Specialist I

Location: 100% Remote (U.S. – candidates must reside in the contiguous United States)

About The Role

As a Cardiac Device Specialist at PaceMate®, you'll join a team of experienced professionals dedicated to improving outcomes for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs). Working remotely, you'll use your expertise in cardiac electrophysiology and device management to analyze remote transmission data and diagnostics, interpret complex arrhythmias, and provide the accurate clinical documentation that providers rely on to guide patient care.

This role requires deep technical knowledge—you'll assess device function across multiple manufacturers, recognize abnormalities and arrhythmias, and recommend strategies to address issues. If you're passionate about applying your CIED expertise in a patient-centered environment that values compassion, integrity, and excellence, we'd like to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor patients with CIEDs using PaceMate's proprietary software

  • Analyze and interpret ECG/EGM data and device diagnostics, identifying abnormal device function and complex arrhythmias

  • Document findings accurately and professionally, communicating with providers as needed according to PaceMate's best practice standards

  • Work independently to manage your daily workflow while collaborating closely with teammates and clinical leadership to ensure efficient, accurate, and timely interpretations

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and PHI protocols

  • Contribute to our patient-centered care philosophy—at PaceMate®, every teammate is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum two years of recent cardiac device management experience, OR successful completion of a formal cardiac rhythm management program

  • Hands-on experience interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for at least three of the four major manufacturers: Medtronic, Abbott, Boston Scientific, and Biotronik

  • Proficiency in ECG/EGM interpretation, including complex arrhythmia recognition

  • Moderate to advanced technical skills

  • Dedicated home workspace free from distractions, with reliable internet connectivity and the ability to work independently while engaging actively with your team throughout the day

  • Ability to pass PaceMate's candidate technical assessment during the interview process

Nice-to-Haves

  • Bachelor's or associate degree in a related field (nursing, cardiovascular technology, biomedical engineering, or similar) not required but strongly preferred
  • IBHRE Certification (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) not required but strongly preferred; CCT or CRAT a plus
  • Industry experience with cardiac rhythm management
  • Proficiency with collaboration tools including Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and Slack

Physical Requirements

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is consistently required to remain in a stationary position, constantly operate a computer or other office equipment, and frequently communicate with customers and employees.

  • Must be able to exchange accurate information, with the ability to effectively utilize voice over internet protocol; and repetitive motions using fingers and forearms in data entry.

  • You must reside within the geography of the territory.

  • You must only work from within the contiguous Unites States.

  • If working from, residing at a location other than your legal address that PaceMate® has on file, employee must inform IT and get approval to do so.

  • Whenever Confidential information is carried by a Pace Mate worker into a foreign country; the information is either stored in some inaccessible form, such as an encrypted external storage media, or always remain in the worker's possession.

  • PaceMate's workers shall not take Secret Pace Mate information into another country unless the permission has been obtained from Physical Security management.

Why Join PaceMate®

Benefits: Full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance; HSA and FSA options; short- and long-term disability; AD&D coverage; 401(k) retirement savings; paid time off; and additional voluntary benefits including legal insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident coverage. We also offer an employee assistance program, financial wellness resources, and discount programs.

Compensation: On top of a Robust Benefit Package, we are targeting a compensation range of $34.61 - 44.23 per hour, depending on education, experience, and certifications. This evening shift will also be eligible for an additional $4.00 per hour for certain hours worked, our generous shift differential.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified, to perform the essential functions.

About PaceMate®

PaceMate® is a patient-centered, tech-enabled cardiac device monitoring platform serving integrated delivery networks and academic health systems nationwide. Vendor-neutral and EMR-agnostic, PaceMate connects every major device manufacturer into a single platform that sits on top of any EHR.

More than 2.3 million patients are managed on the industry’s only research-grade cardiac dataset, validated by 33 peer-reviewed publications, powering AI-driven clinical and operational analytics. A managed patient services model extends clinic capacity and ensures every cardiac device patient is monitored, every time.

Learn more at PaceMate.com

Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

The Project Manager - Data Analytics Lead will lead performance measurement, program evaluation, reporting, decision support, and data-driven modernization for VA TAP. The Lead will integrate quantitative and qualitative information from VA and interagency sources to identify program needs, prioritize improvements, evaluate pilots and modernization initiatives, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for TAP leadership.

The VA Transition Assistance Program (TAP) helps transitioning Service members and their families understand and access the VA benefits, services, and resources available to them as they transition from military to civilian life. VA delivers TAP services at more than 300 military installations across the Continental United States (CONUS) and areas Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) through a network of Benefits Advisors, supported by standardized curriculum, training, program operations, and performance management. The program is part of the broader interagency Transition Assistance Program delivered in partnership with the Department of War, Department of Labor, and other Federal agencies.

Please note that this position is contingent upon award (estimated December 2026). We expect this role to be remote, but periodic travel may be required to support program activities, customer meetings, and operations at U.S. and overseas locations. Travel frequency will vary based on program needs.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead program data collection, management, modeling, analysis, visualization, and reporting activities supporting TAP operations, performance management, and modernization.
  • Develop and implement a performance analysis framework for evaluating TAP performance, outcomes, service delivery, and improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify program gaps, trends, emerging needs, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Integrate and analyze data from VBA, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), other VA organizations, Department of Labor, Department of War, and other relevant interagency sources.
  • Analyze information collected through surveys, interviews, focus groups, and other research methods.
  • Develop program performance metrics and provide monthly and ad hoc performance reporting, dashboards, and decision-support products.
  • Conduct gap analyses, SWOT analyses, data mapping, performance assessments, and other analytical studies.
  • Use analytics to identify and prioritize TAP modernization and continuous-improvement opportunities, including initiatives with the greatest potential operational or programmatic return.
  • Support development of strategic action plans and modernization implementation plans based on analytical findings.
  • Establish measures for pilots and modernization initiatives, evaluate results, and recommend whether and how successful approaches should be scaled.
  • Translate complex analyses into actionable findings and recommendations that can be operationalized by TAP leadership.
  • Prepare executive-level reports, briefings, presentations, and documentation for Government leadership and interagency stakeholders.
  • Support recurring and short-notice Government data calls and ensure analytical products are accurate, defensible, understandable, and appropriate for executive audiences.
  • Coordinate analytics activities with the Program Manager, Operations Lead, Curriculum Lead, Government stakeholders, and interagency partners.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience managing complex data analytics, performance measurement, program evaluation, or decision-support initiatives for large-scale programs.
  • At least 5 years of experience supporting similar initiatives within the Federal Government or Department of War (DoW).
  • Experience managing Government program data collection, modeling, analysis, and development of analytical products used to support program management and executive decision-making.
  • Experience preparing executive-level reports, briefings, and documentation deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience developing performance measures, analytical reports, or decision-support products.
  • Strong project management, analytical, written communication, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA Benefits programs, military transition programs, or Veteran services.
  • Experience developing program evaluation, performance measurement, or continuous-improvement frameworks.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards and data visualizations.
  • Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple Government or interagency sources.
  • Experience with GIS or geospatial data and analysis.
  • Experience designing or analyzing surveys, interviews, focus groups, gap analyses, and/or SWOT analyses.
  • Experience using analytics to support strategic planning, program modernization, pilot evaluation, or continuous improvement.

Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement

About Sapio Sciences

Sapio Sciences is on a mission to accelerate scientific drug discovery and high-throughput clinical and diagnostics for our clients and partners. The Sapio team consists of expert and highly collaborative scientists, software developers, and professionals passionate about providing a best-in-class lab informatics platform and industry-specific solutions.
Sapio is one of the few software providers to offer a truly unified and highly configurable lab informatics platform and a broad suite of purpose-built solutions. The Sapio platform makes it easy for scientists, laboratory, and bio/informatics professionals to streamline and manage their end-to-end laboratory operations, from instrument data integration to workflow and experiment setup to sample and materials management, data management, and scientific data analysis and reporting.

Working at Sapio

At Sapio, we’re not just building lab informatics solutions. We’re creating tools made for the scientist and motivated to make the world a better place.
We understand that lab informatics is about more than managing data or connecting workflows. It’s about making life easier for the scientist and making scientific progress faster for everyone. Our platform delivers the levels of configurability, usability and insight that scientists have only ever dreamed of.
We’re a team of scientists, developers and innovators who question convention and stay focused on what matters most - advancing drug discovery science. We challenge the status quo and respond to the needs at the heart of science with powerful solutions that are simple to use, effortless to evolve and downright easy to love.
As part of the Sapio team, you’ll work in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where your ideas are valued, your growth matters and your work makes a difference. We’re proud to partner with leading labs around the world, from ambitious start-ups to global organisations, who trust Sapio to support discovery, development and diagnostics with industry-first science-aware solutions.

About the role

Experienced commercial talent responsible for leading Sapio teams and activities to develop strategic partnerships with pharma and biotech by consultatively positioning Sapio solutions to solve critical business challenges. Ideal candidates will have a strong understanding of laboratory informatics offerings and the Life Sciences market.

What you'll be doing

  • Responsible for new and repeat sales of Sapio products and professional services to assigned prospects and accounts.
  • Meeting established sales quotas.
  • Accurately forecast customer business commitments.
  • Have a good working knowledge of Sapio’s products and professional service offerings and capabilities. Understand the features and benefits and vale proposition of our products.
  • Build relationships with prospects with the aim of ensuring they remain aware of Sapio’s direction and that Sapio stays aligned to their current and emerging needs.
  • Sell consultatively and make recommendations on the various Sapio product configuration choices and professional service alternatives.
  • Arrange meetings with sales prospects and deliver presentations conveying
  • Communicate the customer's goals and represent the customer's requirements to Sapio colleagues.
  • Manage creation of timely customer proposals and quotations as needed to secure business.
  • Adhere to and manage the sales process while developing the strategy for key customers.
  • Create Account Plans and Opportunities Plans that orchestrate Sapio activities from outbound campaigns to deal closure.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success Management to plan and execute to development of lasting partnerships with ideal Sapio clients.
  • Support lead generation activities including marketing campaigns, events, territory plan development and direct outbound activities.

What we are looking for:

  • Proven sales experience in life science/pharmaceutical or clinical industry, including traditional account management responsibilities, ideally with experience with LIMS/ELN solutions.
  • Proven ability and track record of achieving sales quotas.
  • Ability to travel to global and regional customer accounts as required
  • Proven ability to incept and cultivate high-calibre customer relationships
  • Experienced with a CRM and professional adherence to company standards
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and consistent work approach.
  • Self-disciplined. Able to work independently.
  • Strong prioritization skills and excellent work ethic.
  • Ability to succeed from remote, non-supervised locations.
  • Deliver Company presentations exceptionally.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive and a good team player.
  • Plan and execute responsibilities with minimal direction.
  • Maintain accurate records in Sapio’s CRM of regional sales and prospecting activities, including sales calls, presentations, closed sales, and follow-up activities, including regular management status and call reports.
  • Responsible for active, timely, visible, and ongoing customer communications and occasional conflict resolution.
  • Be familiar with account-related legal documents.
  • Monitor Sapio projects to maintain a continuous knowledge of project status in order to identify potential issues.

It's a bonus if you have the following:

  • Scientific domain understanding in areas across Discovery, Research, Development, Clinical and Manufacturing.
  • An appreciation for the AI landscape disrupting the current lab environment.
  • Familiarity with Value Engineering frameworks and business case creation aligned with selling Enterprise software.
  • Awareness of the competitive landscape and key differentiators
  • AI skills in incorporating tooling to improve both the effectiveness and efficiency of their own and their team’s work.

What we offer:

  • A competitive salary and benefits package
  • Flexibility to work remotely, with opportunities to travel
  • A comprehensive onboarding and training programme
  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and development
  • A collaborative, inclusive and supportive work environment.

Our People

At Sapio Sciences, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our lab informatics solutions are powered not just by technology, but by a shared commitment to our core values—what we proudly call The Sapio Seven, aka EMBRACE:
Embrace the future
Make a difference
Be true partners
Remember why we’re here
Act with empathy
Commit to transparency
Excel in quality
These values shape how we work, how we grow, and how we deliver impact for our clients every day.

Reasonable Adjustments

We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments, at any stage across the application, interview & assessment processes then please let us know. We will work with you to support your needs in confidence.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other status protected by law or regulation. We intend that all qualified applicants be given equal opportunity and that selection decisions are based on job-related factors. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

LeadVenture is looking for a Senior Director, Revenue Analytics & Planning to join our team. This position will report directly to the CRO. This role owns forecast methodology, capacity and quota planning, compensation modeling, conversion and productivity metrics, and annual planning, and serves as a strategic advisor to the CRO on board-level reporting.

LeadVenture is the leading digital platform provider for powersports, RV, marine, trailer, agriculture, and automotive dealers across North America. Our portfolio of brands, including Dealer Spike, InteractRV, Net Driven, Firestorm, and Frazer, provides dealers with website platforms, digital marketing services, and subscription software products that drive traffic, generate leads, and grow revenue.

We are a private equity-backed company in active growth mode, expanding our software and subscription product footprint across an existing customer base of thousands of dealers. Operating multiple brands, multiple products, and multiple sales motions simultaneously is our defining operational challenge — and our biggest opportunity.

The Opportunity

As LeadVenture scales across multiple brands, products, and sales motions, the opportunity is to bring them together under one trusted framework for how we forecast, plan, and model the business — so leadership can make faster, better-informed decisions.

The Senior Director of Revenue Analytics & Planning owns that framework. You will set the methodology behind our forecast, capacity, quota, and compensation models, define the conversion and productivity metrics the business runs on, and lead annual planning from the revenue side. You will be a strategic partner to the CRO and the analytical conscience of the GTM organization: when a number goes in front of leadership or the Board, you are the reason it can be trusted.

This is a senior pillar leadership seat in Revenue Operations, reporting to the Chief Revenue Operations. You will lead the Revenue Analytics & Planning team, so your time goes to judgment, design, and insight, not data pulls.

What You'll OwnForecast Methodology

  • Own the forecast methodology across brands, products, and sales motions — how we call the number, how we weight pipeline, and how we measure and improve accuracy
  • Run forecast accuracy reviews; diagnose misses by brand, segment, and rep and drive the fixes
  • Partner with FP&A to keep the GTM forecast and the financial plan reconciled to one number

Capacity & Quota Planning

  • Build and own the capacity model: headcount, ramp, productivity, attrition, and coverage assumptions that translate a bookings target into a hiring and pipeline plan
  • Own quota-setting methodology and territory/segment allocation; make sure quotas are achievable, defensible, and tied to the plan

Compensation Modeling

  • Model sales compensation plans — cost of sales, payout curves, accelerators, and scenario analysis — and recommend plan design to leadership
  • Monitor plan performance in-year: attainment distribution, payout vs. budget, and unintended behavior

Funnel, Conversion & Productivity Metrics

  • Define and govern the core GTM metrics: stage conversion, velocity, win rate, opportunity creation, pipeline coverage, and rep productivity
  • Establish benchmarks and targets by brand and motion; surface where the funnel is leaking and what it costs
  • Own the Math of the Business — the model that connects activity, pipeline, and bookings to the revenue target

Annual & Operating Planning

  • Lead the revenue side of annual planning: targets, capacity, quota, comp, and pipeline requirements
  • Build scenario models leadership can use to make trade-off decisions quickly

Executive & Board Insight

  • Act as a strategic advisor to the CRO and CEO — turn analysis into clear recommendations and the so-what, not just the chart
  • Own the analytical foundation for monthly board reporting and forecast commentary, and present directly to executive leadership as needed

Team Leadership, Scale & AI Leverage

  • Lead, develop, and scale the Revenue Analytics & Planning team; set priorities, review work, and raise the analytical bar
  • Design how the analytics function scales across brands — including bringing non-Salesforce business units (DCS, Frazer) into one consistent reporting and forecast framework
  • Use AI and automation to remove manual reporting work and scale the function without adding headcount
  • Partner with GTM Systems on data standards so the CRM supports accurate forecasting and reporting

How We Measure Success

Analytics is only valuable if it changes decisions. Success is measured on outcomes, not reports produced.

  • Forecast accuracy — monthly and quarterly, at company and brand level
  • Capacity and quota plans delivered on time and adopted without rework
  • Comp plan cost of sales and attainment distribution in line with plan design
  • Pipeline coverage and conversion visibility that leadership uses to make decisions
  • Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation and AI
  • Executive and Board confidence in the numbers — one source of truth, no competing versions

What We're Looking ForExperience

  • 10+ years in revenue operations, sales strategy & planning, sales finance, or FP&A supporting a GTM organization
  • Direct ownership of forecast methodology, capacity planning, and quota/comp modeling — you have built these models, not just consumed them
  • Has led annual GTM planning cycles end to end at the company or business-unit level
  • Track record presenting analysis and recommendations to C-level and Board audiences — and changing decisions as a result
  • 4+ years building and leading analytics or planning teams
  • Experience in a multi-brand, multi-product, or SaaS + services business strongly preferred; PE-backed experience a plus

Technical Skills

  • Expert Excel / Google Sheets modeling — driver-based, scenario, and sensitivity models others can follow and maintain
  • Strong Salesforce reporting and data-model fluency
  • SQL and a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar) strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with forecasting and revenue intelligence tools (Clari, Gong, or similar) and comp tools a plus

How You Think

  • You build frameworks, not one-off answers — your models survive after you hand them off
  • You lead with the recommendation and can explain it simply; if the CRO can't explain it to his grandmother, you're not done
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers and catch problems before leadership does
  • You are comfortable pushing back on senior stakeholders with data
  • You bias toward speed and simplicity over perfect precision

*This role is not open to candidates located in Colorado, Connecticut, California, Maryland, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, or Washington.

We are an international company with offices located in the United States, Mexico (Juniper Data Center), Belize (Dealer Spike Belize), India and The Netherlands. Together, we are LeadVenture.

Bilingual Medical Assistant / Medical Receptionist (Spanish/English Required)

Remote | Skin Clinic | 30 Hours/Week | $6.5/Hour

Role Overview

We are looking for a reliable and experienced Virtual Medical Assistant / Medical Receptionist to support a busy US-based skin clinic. This role will focus on frontline patient communication, scheduling, insurance verification, and administrative support so the in-clinic team can focus on direct patient care. The clinic serves a high volume of Spanish-speaking patients, so strong bilingual communication in Spanish and English is required.

The ideal candidate is confident handling medical front desk tasks with minimal supervision and already has experience supporting a US-based healthcare practice.

Cultural Fit & Core Values

At this clinic, culture is everything. For nearly five decades, both staff and patients have been accustomed to an environment that feels like family.

We are looking for an individual who is naturally warm, friendly, and deeply empathetic.

You must bring a welcoming energy not only to the patients calling in but also to your relationship with the clinic staff.

If you naturally treat patients and colleagues like family and take pride in going above and beyond, you will thrive in their environment.

Key Responsibilities

Phone Management

  • Answer inbound calls promptly and professionally.

  • Assist patients with questions, appointment needs, and general clinic inquiries.

  • Route concerns appropriately and document call details accurately.

Appointment Scheduling

  • Manage the clinic calendar and schedule patient appointments.

  • Reschedule, cancel, and update appointments as needed.

  • Confirm appointment details and help maintain an organized daily schedule.

Insurance Verification

  • Verify patient insurance coverage and eligibility.

  • Confirm active benefits, plan details, and patient responsibility when needed.

  • Update insurance information accurately in the patient record.

Prior Authorizations

  • Coordinate prior requests for treatments or medications.

  • Gather required patient, insurance, and clinical information for submission.

  • Track authorization status and follow up with payers when needed.

Requirements

  • Must be fully fluent in both Spanish and English.

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience supporting a US-based medical clinic.

  • Strong experience with medical receptionist or front desk tasks.

  • Comfortable handling patient calls in a busy healthcare setting.

  • Knowledge of insurance verification and prior authorization workflows.

  • Organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

  • Must be comfortable working remotely in a dedicated clinic support role.

Schedule and Work Setup

  • 30 hours per week.

  • Remote work setup.

  • Immediate hiring need.

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is best suited for someone who is polished on the phone, confident with patient communication, and experienced in US healthcare administrative workflows. The strongest candidate will be someone who can step into the role quickly, manage calls professionally, support Spanish-speaking patients, and help keep the clinic's front desk operations running smoothly.

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.</p>
<p>Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:</li>
<ul>
<li>Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them</li>
<li>Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them</li>
<li>Automating processes where manual processes exist.</li>
</ul>
<li>Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).</li>
<li>Managing access to key infrastructure.</li>
<li>Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.</li>
<li>Automate local development workflows.</li>
<li>Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.</li>
<li>Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.</li>
<li>Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field</li>
<li>1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems</li>
<li>Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.</li>
<li>Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li>
<li>Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.</li>
<li>Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go</li>
<li>Knowledge of Maven or similar build environments</li>
<li>Hands on experience in pipeline automation using CI/CD tools like Jenkins&nbsp;</li>

<li>Experience with Terraform, BASH, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes</li>
<li>Ability to write technical reports, effectively summarizing key data</li>
<li>Passion for learning and then delivering solutions using latest technologies</li>
<li>Strong Affinity for collaboration and teamwork</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Working knowledge in data lakes and data warehousing</li>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.</li>
<li>Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.</li>
<li>Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.</li>
<li>Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.</li>
<li>Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.</li>
<li>Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.</li>
<li>Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.</li>
<li>Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.</li>
<li>Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.</li>
<li>Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.</li>
<li>Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Open source: Contributing to open-source projects.</li>

      <title>Toggl: Senior Full Stack</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/7274/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://toggl.com/jobs/">https://toggl.com/jobs/</a>
</p>

<div class="_descriptionText_5yu8i_201 ashby-job-posting-description">
<p>We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.</p>
<p>You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.</p>
<p>The salary for this position is&nbsp;<strong>€83,000 annually.</strong></p>
<p>You can work from anywhere in the world&nbsp;<strong>as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.</p>
<p>You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.</p>
<p>Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.</p>
<p>Your main responsibilities will be:</p>
<p><strong>Ownership and delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Craft and quality across the stack</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Working with product and design</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Raising the bar</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>AI as core leverage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>You will thrive in this role if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have deep, practical knowledge of&nbsp;<strong>JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS</strong>&nbsp;- including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does.&nbsp;<strong>Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role Is NOT</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA<br>team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your<br>tests, or own your performance regressions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Team</strong></p>
<p>We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/culture/">Our values</a>&nbsp;fuel our results.<br><br><strong>What's Happening at Toggl</strong></p>
<p>Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger:&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/focus/">Toggl 2.0</a>. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.</p>

      <title>Glean: Application Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Glean is looking for an experienced <strong>Application Security Engineer</strong> with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w"><span>Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.</span></li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).</span></li>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).</span>&nbsp;</li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.</span></li>
<li><span>Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></p>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen">&nbsp;</span></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0076/3373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, Arizona
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://adventuretravel365.com/">https://adventuretravel365.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web &amp; Mobile Platform</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a <strong>top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer</strong> to help us bring it to life.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think <strong>Thumbtack or Angi</strong>, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Help Us Build</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The platform will have two main sides: <strong>clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles</li>
<li>Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering</li>
<li>Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management</li>
<li>Job and project tracking</li>
<li>Client and vendor dashboards</li>
<li>Online payments and transaction tracking</li>
<li>Reviews and ratings</li>
<li>Notifications and communications</li>
<li>Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities</li>
<li>Admin tools for managing the platform</li>
<li>Reporting and analytics</li>
<li>Secure management of user, job, and transaction data</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to <strong>grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.</strong></p>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’d love to find someone with strong experience in <strong>full-stack web and mobile development</strong>, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-stack web development</li>
<li>Mobile or cross-platform app development</li>
<li>Strong front-end <strong>and</strong> back-end development</li>
<li>Multi-user marketplace platforms</li>
<li>User authentication and account management</li>
<li>Payment gateway integrations</li>
<li>Databases and APIs</li>
<li>Third-party integrations</li>
<li>Dashboards and reporting</li>
<li>Secure, scalable application architecture</li>
<li>Cloud hosting and deployment</li>
<li>Testing, maintenance, and optimization</li>
<li>Using modern <strong>AI-powered development tools</strong> and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">If you’ve worked on something similar to <strong>Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace</strong>, we definitely want to hear about it.</p>
<h2>More Than Just Coding</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also be expected to <strong>study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi</strong>, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be able to take the project through <strong>planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond</strong>, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important.</strong> You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is <strong>not a short-term build-and-leave project.</strong> We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.</p>
<h2>Interested? Tell Us About Yourself</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Please send us:</p>
<ul>
<li>A quick introduction</li>
<li>Your resume or LinkedIn profile</li>
<li>Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built</li>
<li>Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on</li>
<li>What <strong>you personally worked on</strong> for those projects</li>
<li>Your experience using AI in development</li>
<li>What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why</li>
<li>Your availability</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>A short video introduction would be great, too!</strong> Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.</p>
<p>Most importantly, <strong>show us what you’ve built.</strong> If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Cloud Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SF, NYC, or Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join Hex’s security team. You will be responsible for ensuring the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure, providing leadership in cloud security practices, and collaborating closely with our infrastructure and engineering teams to secure our cloud-native applications.</p>
<hr>
<h3>About the role:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design, implement, and manage security solutions and controls for AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters, including appropriate isolation/sandboxing methods for Hex’s RCE-as-a-Service platform</li>
<li>Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring robust security standards are enforced.</li>
<li>Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and audits on AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
<li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed security best practices into CI/CD pipelines.</li>
<li>Monitor and respond to cloud security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation actions.</li>
<li>Provide expertise in compliance requirements related to cloud security (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).</li>
<li>Mentor engineers and advocate for cloud security across the organization.</li>
</ul>
<h3>About you:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with extensive expertise in AWS.</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency with Kubernetes security including cluster hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and container vulnerability management.</li>
<li>Expert-level knowledge and hands-on experience with Terraform.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AWS security services (e.g., IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF).</li>
<li>Familiarity with CNAPP solutions such as Wiz</li>
<li>Familiarity with SIEM solutions such as Panther</li>
<li>Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD security, and DevSecOps methodologies.</li>
<li>Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), and Terraform Associate certification are highly desirable.</li>
<li>Bonus points for security certifications from SANS or OffSec.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>Our Engineering team</h3>
<p>We’re a group of engineers who are forging new ground together and love partnering with Security on our journey to pull ahead of our competition. You can read about how we think through problems as well as how we learn from mistakes on our blog here:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/we-took-down-production/">How we took down production…</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/beyond-linear-notebooks/">Beyond Linear Notebooks</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/a-pragmatic-approach-to-live-collaboration/">A pragmatic approach to live collaboration</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 class="Heading__HeadingInternal-sc-sir940-0 Heading___StyledHeadingInternal-sc-sir940-1 eQrUa-d">Our stack</h3>
<p>Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $198,750 - $295,000</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>

to develop and maintain accurate data mappings between systems.</li><li>Debug and resolve production integration failures independently, including root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.</li><li>Instrument integration pipelines with appropriate monitoring, logging, and alerting.</li><li>Support Marketing Portfolio transition integrations while avoiding unnecessary point-to-point dependencies and new integration debt.</li><li>Use AI tools to accelerate mapping drafts, API stubs, test generation, documentation, and error-handling boilerplate.</li><li>Review and harden AI-generated output to ensure it meets production standards for reliability, maintainability, and quality.</li><li>Automate replay, retry, alerting, and recovery runbooks to reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR).</li><li>Continuously improve the reliability, observability, and operational efficiency of the integrations you own.</li></ul><p><strong>Required experience</strong></p><ul><li>5+ years of integration engineering experience.</li><li>Hands-on experience with MuleSoft or an equivalent enterprise ESB/API integration platform.</li><li>Experience integrating with SAP, including IDoc, API, and/or BAPI patterns.</li><li>Experience with Salesforce integrations and enterprise API patterns.</li><li>Experience with data lake ingestion and integration patterns.</li><li>Strong understanding of API contracts, data mapping, transformations, testing, and integration architecture.</li><li>Demonstrated experience supporting integrations in production, including monitoring, troubleshooting, alerting, retry/replay, and incident resolution.</li><li>Ability to take ownership of production issues and drive them through diagnosis, recovery, and prevention, rather than simply handing them off to another team.</li><li>Experience using AI copilots or agents to accelerate software engineering workflows.</li><li>Strong engineering judgment and the ability to validate, test, and improve AI-generated code and artifacts before they reach production.</li></ul>
